description: This file contains utility functions for handling video frames and GPU memory buffers on ChromeOS, including creation, import, and validation of native pixmap buffers, with a focus on DRM and GBM integration.

classes.name: GbmDeviceWrapper
classes.description: Singleton class providing thread-safe access to a GBM device for creating and importing GPU memory buffers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GbmDeviceWrapper.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a native GPU memory buffer handle with specified format, size, and usage.

methods.name: ImportGpuMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Imports a GPU memory buffer from a native pixmap handle.

methods.name: GetNextGpuMemoryBufferId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for GPU memory buffers.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBufferVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame backed by a GPU memory buffer.

methods.name: CreatePlatformVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific VideoFrame from a GPU memory buffer handle.

methods.name: GetPlatformVideoFrameLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of a platform video frame for given format and size.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBufferHandle
methods.description: Creates a GPU memory buffer handle from a VideoFrame.

methods.name: CreateNativePixmapDmaBuf
methods.description: Creates a NativePixmapDmaBuf from a VideoFrame.

methods.name: CanImportGpuMemoryBufferHandle
methods.description: Checks if a GPU memory buffer handle can be imported for given size and format.
